BiblicalUsage: Soon angry is one of the marks Paul forbids in an elder: a bishop must be blameless, not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a quick temper disqualifies a leader because it wounds the very people he is meant to shepherd.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
